title: Delete an identity provider configuration (execute)
description: Step 2 of 2 for delete identity provider configuration. Verifies the confirmation_hash from -prepare and the literal "confirm" string typed by the user, then performs the action. ONLY call this after the user has explicitly typed "confirm" in chat. Original action: Permanently delete an identity provider configuration by its ID. This removes its SAML, OIDC, SCIM, or XAA settings and its linked organization domains. The delete call requires explicit user confirmation.
